package main

// The intent corpora (RB9 Phase D): BindProofV21, GoverningFactsFromVoteEvidence and govRoot v4 (pages root, votes root, EncodeVoteV4) over
// scenarios, and the decode / view of a certificate's proof v2. Every scenario is a JSON value; the validator's own functions give its verdict;
// the TypeScript tests apply the same value to their port and must agree on every field.

import (
	"bytes"
	"encoding/hex"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"math/rand"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"strings"

	"github.com/certen/independant-validator/accumulate-lite-client-2/liteclient/proof/govvote"
	"github.com/certen/independant-validator/pkg/intentcert"
	"github.com/certen/independant-validator/pkg/proof"
	proofv2 "github.com/certen/independant-validator/pkg/proof/v2"
	"gitlab.com/accumulatenetwork/accumulate/pkg/url"
	"gitlab.com/accumulatenetwork/accumulate/protocol"
)

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
// the scenario

type NamedOut struct {
	Code      string `json:"code"`
	Partition string `json:"partition"`
	Block     uint64 `json:"block"`
	Detail    string `json:"detail"`
}

type XReport struct {
	Partition             string      `json:"partition"`
	AnchorBlock           uint64      `json:"anchorBlock"`
	CertifiedBlock        uint64      `json:"certifiedBlock"`
	SetVerdict            string      `json:"setVerdict"`
	Incarnation           string      `json:"incarnation"`
	CertifiedRoot         string      `json:"certifiedRoot"`
	TxHash                string      `json:"txHash"`
	AnchorTxHash          string      `json:"anchorTxHash"`
	AnchorStateRoot       string      `json:"anchorStateRoot"`
	AnchorRootChainAnchor string      `json:"anchorRootChainAnchor"`
	AccumulateSetRoot     string      `json:"accumulateSetRoot"`
	Pages                 []string    `json:"pages"`
	PageChains            []ChainOut  `json:"pageChains"`
	Proven                []ProvenOut `json:"proven"`
	Unproven              []NamedOut  `json:"unproven"`
	Disclosures           []NamedOut  `json:"disclosures"`
}

type XEvPage struct {
	URL       string   `json:"url"`
	State     string   `json:"state"`
	Partition string   `json:"partition"`
	Roles     []string `json:"roles"`
}

type XEvidence struct {
	Version string         `json:"version"`
	Account string         `json:"account"`
	Pages   []XEvPage      `json:"pages"`
	Votes   []proofv2.Vote `json:"votes"`
}

type XG0 struct {
	EntryHashExec string `json:"entryHashExec"`
	ReceiptStart  string `json:"receiptStart"`
	ExecWitness   string `json:"execWitness"`
	ExecMBI       int64  `json:"execMBI"`
}

type XAuthority struct {
	URL      string `json:"url"`
	Disabled bool   `json:"disabled"`
}
type XSig struct {
	Signer string `json:"signer"`
	Block  int64  `json:"block"`
}
type XVote struct {
	Authority string `json:"authority"`
	Origin    string `json:"origin"`
	Block     int64  `json:"block"`
}
type XArrival struct {
	Page   string   `json:"page"`
	Origin string   `json:"origin"`
	Path   []string `json:"path"`
	Block  int64    `json:"block"`
}
type XFacts struct {
	Principal         string       `json:"principal"`
	Type              uint64       `json:"type"`
	TxHash            string       `json:"txHash"`
	Authorities       []XAuthority `json:"authorities"`
	HeaderAuthorities []string     `json:"headerAuthorities"`
	Initiators        []string     `json:"initiators"`
	InitiatorPath     []string     `json:"initiatorPath"`
	Signatures        []XSig       `json:"signatures"`
	Votes             []XVote      `json:"votes"`
	Arrivals          []XArrival   `json:"arrivals"`
}

type XHashes struct {
	G0Hash      string `json:"g0Hash"`
	G1Hash      string `json:"g1Hash"`
	G2Hash      string `json:"g2Hash"`
	OperationID string `json:"operationId"`
}

// RootCase is one scenario. Mode "bind" runs BindProofV21 over Facts; "root" is the 2.1 branch of ProofV2Root (the facts read from
// VoteEvidence, BindProofV21, govRoot v4 over the hashes); "govroot" is GovRootV4FromPortable alone.
type RootCase struct {
	Mode         string          `json:"mode"`
	Report       XReport         `json:"report"`
	Evidence     XEvidence       `json:"evidence"`
	G0           XG0             `json:"g0"`
	G1Page       string          `json:"g1Page"`
	KeyPage      string          `json:"keyPage"`
	KeyBook      string          `json:"keyBook"`
	Facts        XFacts          `json:"facts"`
	VoteEvidence json.RawMessage `json:"voteEvidence,omitempty"`
	Hashes       XHashes         `json:"hashes"`
}

type RootOut struct {
	V         string            `json:"v"` // ok | named | plain
	Root      string            `json:"root,omitempty"`
	PagesRoot string            `json:"pagesRoot,omitempty"`
	VotesRoot string            `json:"votesRoot,omitempty"`
	Slots     map[string]string `json:"slots,omitempty"`
	Bind      bool              `json:"bind,omitempty"`
	State     *NamedOut         `json:"state,omitempty"`
	Msg       string            `json:"msg,omitempty"`
}

func hexN(s string, n int) ([]byte, bool) {
	b, err := hex.DecodeString(s)
	return b, err == nil && len(b) == n
}

func a32(s string) ([32]byte, bool) {
	var o [32]byte
	b, ok := hexN(s, 32)
	if ok {
		copy(o[:], b)
	}
	return o, ok
}

func namedOuts(in []proofv2.NamedState) []NamedOut {
	out := []NamedOut{}
	for _, s := range in {
		out = append(out, NamedOut{s.Code, s.Partition, s.Block, s.Detail})
	}
	return out
}

func rolesOut(in []proofv2.PageRole) []string {
	out := []string{}
	for _, r := range in {
		out = append(out, string(r))
	}
	return out
}

func rolesIn(in []string) []proofv2.PageRole {
	var out []proofv2.PageRole
	for _, r := range in {
		out = append(out, proofv2.PageRole(r))
	}
	return out
}

// caseOf writes a report, its evidence and the governing inputs as a scenario.
func caseOf(rep *proofv2.Report, ev *proofv2.Evidence, g0 *proof.G0Result, g1Page, keyPage, keyBook string, facts *intentcert.GoverningFacts, ve json.RawMessage, h XHashes, mode string) *RootCase {
	c := &RootCase{Mode: mode, G0: XG0{g0.EntryHashExec, g0.Receipt.Start, g0.ExecWitness, g0.ExecMBI}, G1Page: g1Page, KeyPage: keyPage, KeyBook: keyBook, VoteEvidence: ve, Hashes: h}
	c.Report = XReport{Partition: rep.Partition, AnchorBlock: rep.AnchorBlock, CertifiedBlock: rep.CertifiedBlock, SetVerdict: string(rep.SetVerdict),
		Incarnation: hx(rep.Incarnation), CertifiedRoot: hx(rep.CertifiedRoot), TxHash: hx(rep.TxHash), AnchorTxHash: hx(rep.AnchorTxHash),
		AnchorStateRoot: hx(rep.AnchorStateRoot), AnchorRootChainAnchor: hx(rep.AnchorRootChainAnchor), AccumulateSetRoot: hx(rep.AccumulateSetRoot),
		Pages: []string{}, PageChains: []ChainOut{}, Proven: []ProvenOut{}, Unproven: namedOuts(rep.Unproven), Disclosures: namedOuts(rep.Disclosures)}
	for _, a := range rep.Pages {
		b, err := a.MarshalBinary()
		if err != nil {
			panic(err)
		}
		c.Report.Pages = append(c.Report.Pages, hex.EncodeToString(b))
	}
	for _, p := range rep.PageChains {
		c.Report.PageChains = append(c.Report.PageChains, ChainOut{p.URL, p.Bound, p.MainHeight})
	}
	for _, p := range rep.Proven {
		c.Report.Proven = append(c.Report.Proven, ProvenOut{p.URL, p.Partition, p.Block, rolesOut(p.Roles), rolesOut(p.Declared)})
	}
	c.Evidence = XEvidence{Version: ev.Version, Account: ev.Account, Votes: ev.Votes}
	for _, p := range ev.Pages {
		c.Evidence.Pages = append(c.Evidence.Pages, XEvPage{p.URL, p.State, p.Partition, rolesOut(p.Roles)})
	}
	if facts != nil {
		c.Facts = XFacts{Principal: facts.Principal, Type: uint64(facts.Type), TxHash: hx(facts.TxHash), Authorities: []XAuthority{}, HeaderAuthorities: append([]string{}, facts.HeaderAuthorities...),
			Initiators: append([]string{}, facts.Initiators...), InitiatorPath: append([]string{}, facts.InitiatorPath...), Signatures: []XSig{}, Votes: []XVote{}, Arrivals: []XArrival{}}
		for _, a := range facts.Authorities {
			c.Facts.Authorities = append(c.Facts.Authorities, XAuthority{a.URL, a.Disabled})
		}
		for _, s := range facts.Signatures {
			c.Facts.Signatures = append(c.Facts.Signatures, XSig{s.Signer, s.Block})
		}
		for _, v := range facts.Votes {
			c.Facts.Votes = append(c.Facts.Votes, XVote{v.Authority, v.Origin, v.Block})
		}
		for _, a := range facts.Arrivals {
			c.Facts.Arrivals = append(c.Facts.Arrivals, XArrival{a.Page, a.Origin, append([]string{}, a.Path...), a.Block})
		}
	} else {
		c.Facts = XFacts{TxHash: strings.Repeat("00", 32)}
	}
	return c
}

// decodeCase rebuilds the validator's values from a scenario. ok is false when the scenario is not one the validator's types can hold
// (a mutation then has no verdict: it is not recorded).
func decodeCase(c *RootCase) (rep *proofv2.Report, ev *proofv2.Evidence, g0 *proof.G0Result, g1 *proof.G1Result, facts *intentcert.GoverningFacts, ok bool) {
	rep = &proofv2.Report{Partition: c.Report.Partition, AnchorBlock: c.Report.AnchorBlock, CertifiedBlock: c.Report.CertifiedBlock, SetVerdict: proof.Verdict(c.Report.SetVerdict)}
	for _, f := range []struct {
		s   string
		out *[32]byte
	}{{c.Report.Incarnation, &rep.Incarnation}, {c.Report.CertifiedRoot, &rep.CertifiedRoot}, {c.Report.TxHash, &rep.TxHash}, {c.Report.AnchorTxHash, &rep.AnchorTxHash},
		{c.Report.AnchorStateRoot, &rep.AnchorStateRoot}, {c.Report.AnchorRootChainAnchor, &rep.AnchorRootChainAnchor}, {c.Report.AccumulateSetRoot, &rep.AccumulateSetRoot}} {
		v, good := a32(f.s)
		if !good {
			return nil, nil, nil, nil, nil, false
		}
		*f.out = v
	}
	for _, s := range c.Report.Pages {
		b, err := hex.DecodeString(s)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, nil, nil, nil, nil, false
		}
		a, err := protocol.UnmarshalAccount(b)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, nil, nil, nil, nil, false
		}
		rep.Pages = append(rep.Pages, a)
	}
	for _, p := range c.Report.PageChains {
		rep.PageChains = append(rep.PageChains, proofv2.PageChain{URL: p.URL, Bound: p.Bound, MainHeight: p.MainHeight})
	}
	for _, p := range c.Report.Proven {
		rep.Proven = append(rep.Proven, proofv2.ProvenPage{URL: p.URL, Partition: p.Partition, Block: p.Block, Roles: rolesIn(p.Roles), Declared: rolesIn(p.Declared)})
	}
	for _, n := range c.Report.Unproven {
		rep.Unproven = append(rep.Unproven, proofv2.NamedState{Code: n.Code, Partition: n.Partition, Block: n.Block, Detail: n.Detail})
	}
	for _, n := range c.Report.Disclosures {
		rep.Disclosures = append(rep.Disclosures, proofv2.NamedState{Code: n.Code, Partition: n.Partition, Block: n.Block, Detail: n.Detail})
	}
	ev = &proofv2.Evidence{Version: c.Evidence.Version, Account: c.Evidence.Account, Votes: c.Evidence.Votes}
	for _, p := range c.Evidence.Pages {
		ev.Pages = append(ev.Pages, proofv2.PageState{URL: p.URL, State: p.State, Partition: p.Partition, Roles: rolesIn(p.Roles)})
	}
	g0 = &proof.G0Result{EntryHashExec: c.G0.EntryHashExec, ExecWitness: c.G0.ExecWitness, ExecMBI: c.G0.ExecMBI}
	g0.Receipt.Start = c.G0.ReceiptStart
	g1 = &proof.G1Result{}
	g1.AuthoritySnapshot.Page = c.G1Page
	facts = &intentcert.GoverningFacts{Principal: c.Facts.Principal, Type: protocol.TransactionType(c.Facts.Type), HeaderAuthorities: c.Facts.HeaderAuthorities,
		Initiators: c.Facts.Initiators, InitiatorPath: c.Facts.InitiatorPath}
	th, good := a32(c.Facts.TxHash)
	if !good {
		return nil, nil, nil, nil, nil, false
	}
	facts.TxHash = th
	for _, a := range c.Facts.Authorities {
		facts.Authorities = append(facts.Authorities, govvote.AccountAuthority{URL: a.URL, Disabled: a.Disabled})
	}
	for _, s := range c.Facts.Signatures {
		facts.Signatures = append(facts.Signatures, intentcert.SignatureRef{Signer: s.Signer, Block: s.Block})
	}
	for _, v := range c.Facts.Votes {
		facts.Votes = append(facts.Votes, intentcert.VoteRef{Authority: v.Authority, Origin: v.Origin, Block: v.Block})
	}
	for _, a := range c.Facts.Arrivals {
		facts.Arrivals = append(facts.Arrivals, intentcert.ArrivalRef{Page: a.Page, Origin: a.Origin, Path: a.Path, Block: a.Block})
	}
	return rep, ev, g0, g1, facts, true
}

// runCase judges a scenario with the validator's functions. ok is false when Go panics or the scenario cannot be held.
func runCase(c *RootCase) (out RootOut, ok bool) {
	defer func() {
		if r := recover(); r != nil {
			lastPanic = fmt.Sprintf("%v | %s", r, topFrames(stackNow(), 6))
			ok = false
		}
	}()
	rep, ev, g0, g1, facts, good := decodeCase(c)
	if !good {
		return out, false
	}
	fail := func(err error, isBind bool) (RootOut, bool) {
		o := RootOut{Bind: isBind, Msg: err.Error()}
		var ns *proofv2.NamedState
		if errors.As(err, &ns) {
			o.V, o.State = "named", &NamedOut{ns.Code, ns.Partition, ns.Block, ns.Detail}
		} else {
			o.V = "plain"
		}
		return o, true
	}
	hashes := &proofv2.PortableGovRootV3Inputs{G0Hash: c.Hashes.G0Hash, G1Hash: c.Hashes.G1Hash, G2Hash: c.Hashes.G2Hash, KeyPageURL: c.KeyPage, KeyBookURL: c.KeyBook, OperationID: c.Hashes.OperationID}
	root := func() (RootOut, bool) {
		r, slots, err := intentcert.GovRootV4FromPortable(rep, ev, hashes)
		if err != nil {
			return fail(err, false)
		}
		o := RootOut{V: "ok", Root: hx(r), Slots: map[string]string{"L1": hx(slots.L1AccountHash), "L2": hx(slots.L2BPTRoot), "L3": hx(slots.L3BlockHash), "L4": hx(slots.L4ConsensusProofH),
			"G0": hx(slots.G0CanonicalHash), "G1": hx(slots.G1CanonicalHash), "G2": hx(slots.G2CanonicalHash), "keyPage": hx(slots.KeypageURLHash), "keyBook": hx(slots.KeybookURLHash), "operationId": hx(slots.OperationID)}}
		if p, err := intentcert.PagesRootV4(rep, ev); err == nil {
			o.PagesRoot = hx(p)
		}
		if v, err := intentcert.VotesRootV4(ev.Votes); err == nil {
			o.VotesRoot = hx(v)
		}
		return o, true
	}
	switch c.Mode {
	case "govroot":
		return root()
	case "bind":
		if err := intentcert.BindProofV21(rep, g0, g1, c.KeyPage, c.KeyBook, facts); err != nil {
			return fail(err, false)
		}
		return RootOut{V: "ok"}, true
	case "root":
		// ProofV2Root, evidence 2.1: the facts of the intent's own vote evidence, BindProofV21, govRoot v4 (over the governance hashes given).
		switch ev.Version {
		case proofv2.Version21:
		case proofv2.Version:
			// Evidence 2.0: BindProofV2, then govRoot v3 over the same hashes.
			if err := intentcert.BindProofV2(rep, g0, g1, c.KeyPage); err != nil {
				return fail(fmt.Errorf("%w: %w", intentcert.ErrBind, err), true)
			}
			r, slots, err := intentcert.GovRootV3FromPortable(rep, ev, hashes)
			if err != nil {
				return fail(err, false)
			}
			o := RootOut{V: "ok", Root: hx(r), Slots: map[string]string{"L1": hx(slots.L1AccountHash), "L2": hx(slots.L2BPTRoot), "L3": hx(slots.L3BlockHash), "L4": hx(slots.L4ConsensusProofH),
				"G0": hx(slots.G0CanonicalHash), "G1": hx(slots.G1CanonicalHash), "G2": hx(slots.G2CanonicalHash), "keyPage": hx(slots.KeypageURLHash), "keyBook": hx(slots.KeybookURLHash), "operationId": hx(slots.OperationID)}}
			if p, err := intentcert.PagesRootV3(rep, ev); err == nil {
				o.PagesRoot = hx(p)
			}
			return o, true
		default:
			return fail(fmt.Errorf("proof v2 root: evidence version %q is neither %s nor %s", ev.Version, proofv2.Version, proofv2.Version21), false)
		}
		var gev govvote.Evidence
		if len(c.VoteEvidence) == 0 || json.Unmarshal(c.VoteEvidence, &gev) != nil {
			return fail(fmt.Errorf("proof v2 root: evidence 2.1 is bound to the intent's vote evidence, which is missing or malformed"), false)
		}
		fs, err := intentcert.GoverningFactsFromVoteEvidence(&gev)
		if err != nil {
			return fail(fmt.Errorf("%w: %w", intentcert.ErrBind, err), true)
		}
		if err := intentcert.BindProofV21(rep, g0, g1, c.KeyPage, c.KeyBook, fs); err != nil {
			return fail(fmt.Errorf("%w: %w", intentcert.ErrBind, err), true)
		}
		return root()
	}
	panic("unknown mode " + c.Mode)
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
// the bases

func hashesOf(b byte) XHashes { return XHashes{hx32(b), hx32(b + 1), hx32(b + 2), hx32(b + 3)} }

// ve builds the vote evidence of the fixture intent: the facts it yields are those of the fixture's governing set.
func x21VoteEvidence(f *x21) (govvote.Evidence, [32]byte, error) {
	txn := &protocol.Transaction{Body: &protocol.SendTokens{To: []*protocol.TokenRecipient{{Url: mustURL("acc://to.acme/tokens"), Amount: *bigOne()}}}}
	txn.Header.Principal = mustURL(xPrincipal)
	txn.Header.Authorities = append(txn.Header.Authorities, mustURL(xHdrBook))
	inner := &protocol.ED25519Signature{PublicKey: keyHash(1), Signature: keyHash(2), Signer: mustURL(xERPDeleg), SignerVersion: 1, Timestamp: 5}
	initiating := &protocol.DelegatedSignature{Signature: inner, Delegator: mustURL(xERP)}
	copy(txn.Header.Initiator[:], initiating.Metadata().Hash())
	other := &protocol.ED25519Signature{PublicKey: keyHash(3), Signature: keyHash(4), Signer: mustURL(xDelPage), SignerVersion: 1, Timestamp: 6}
	enc := func(s protocol.Signature) string {
		b, err := s.MarshalBinary()
		if err != nil {
			panic(err)
		}
		return hex.EncodeToString(b)
	}
	tb, err := txn.MarshalBinary()
	if err != nil {
		return govvote.Evidence{}, [32]byte{}, err
	}
	ev := govvote.Evidence{
		Version: govvote.EvidenceVersion, Account: xPrincipal, Transaction: hex.EncodeToString(tb),
		Authorities: []govvote.AccountAuthority{{URL: xBook}},
		Signatures: []govvote.SignatureEvidence{
			{Fact: govvote.SigFact{ID: "a", Signer: canon(xDelPage), Block: blkY3 - 10}, Signature: enc(other)},
			{Fact: govvote.SigFact{ID: "b", Signer: canon(xERPDeleg), Path: []string{canon(xERP)}, Block: blkY3 - 5}, Signature: enc(initiating)},
		},
		Votes:    []govvote.VoteEvidence{{Fact: govvote.RecordedVote{ID: "v", Authority: canon(xBook), Origin: canon(xBook2), Block: blkX - 4}}},
		Arrivals: []govvote.ArrivalEvidence{{Fact: govvote.ArrivalFact{ID: "r", Page: canon(xBook2), Origin: canon(xDelPage), Block: blkY2 - 6}}},
	}
	var h [32]byte
	copy(h[:], txn.GetHash())
	return ev, h, nil
}

// syntheticBase is the fixture intent with its transaction's real hash: facts from its vote evidence bind to its report.
func syntheticBase() (*x21, *RootCase) {
	f := newX21()
	ve, th, err := x21VoteEvidence(f)
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	facts, err := intentcert.GoverningFactsFromVoteEvidence(&ve)
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	f.facts = *facts
	rep, g0, g1, kp := f.report()
	rep.TxHash = th
	g0.EntryHashExec, g0.Receipt.Start = hx(th), hx(th)
	ev := f.evidence(rep)
	raw, _ := json.Marshal(ve)
	return f, caseOf(rep, ev, g0, g1.AuthoritySnapshot.Page, kp, xERPBook, facts, raw, hashesOf(40), "root")
}

func mustRun(c *RootCase, want string) RootOut {
	o, ok := runCase(c)
	if !ok || o.V != want {
		panic(fmt.Sprintf("base case (%s) is %+v, want %s", c.Mode, o, want))
	}
	return o
}

// base20 is the fixture intent as evidence 2.0 reports it: every page of the transaction's partition, no proven records, no roles, no votes.
func base20(b *RootCase) *RootCase {
	c := *b
	c.Mode = "root"
	c.Report.Proven = []ProvenOut{}
	c.Report.Unproven = []NamedOut{}
	c.Report.Disclosures = []NamedOut{}
	c.Evidence.Version = proofv2.Version
	c.Evidence.Votes = nil
	pages := make([]XEvPage, len(c.Evidence.Pages))
	for i, p := range c.Evidence.Pages {
		pages[i] = XEvPage{URL: p.URL, State: p.State}
	}
	c.Evidence.Pages = pages
	return &c
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
// the named scenarios: the cases of pkg/intentcert/bind_v21_test.go, run by BindProofV21 over the fixture's facts

type namedCase struct {
	Name string
	C    *RootCase
	Out  RootOut
}

func bindOf(f *x21) *RootCase {
	rep, g0, g1, kp := f.report()
	ev := f.evidence(rep)
	facts := f.facts
	return caseOf(rep, ev, g0, g1.AuthoritySnapshot.Page, kp, xERPBook, &facts, nil, hashesOf(40), "bind")
}

func chainOf(n int) *x21 {
	f := newX21()
	f.facts.Arrivals, f.facts.Votes = nil, nil
	f.drop(xDelBook).drop(xDelPage)
	f.add(page(xBook2, "acc://d0.acme/book"), partBVN2, blkY2, proofv2.RoleAuthorityPage)
	for i := 0; i < n; i++ {
		b, p := fmt.Sprintf("acc://d%d.acme/book", i), fmt.Sprintf("acc://d%d.acme/book/1", i)
		next := fmt.Sprintf("acc://d%d.acme/book", i+1)
		f.add(book(b, 1), partBVN3, blkY3, proofv2.RoleDelegateBook)
		f.add(page(p, next), partBVN3, blkY3, proofv2.RoleDelegatePage)
	}
	return f
}

func namedScenarios() []namedCase {
	var out []namedCase
	add := func(name string, c *RootCase) {
		o, ok := runCase(c)
		if !ok {
			panic("named scenario " + name + " has no verdict")
		}
		out = append(out, namedCase{name, c, o})
	}
	add("complete governing set", bindOf(newX21()))
	add("harbor: initiator page not proven", bindOf(newX21().drop(xERP)))
	add("harbor: certified but not as initiator", bindOf(newX21().roles(xERP, proofv2.RoleVoter)))
	add("harbor: initiator but not certified", bindOf(newX21().declare(xERP)))
	{
		f := newX21()
		rep, g0, g1, kp := f.report()
		for i := range rep.Proven {
			if canon(rep.Proven[i].URL) == canon(xERP) {
				rep.Proven[i].Roles, rep.Proven[i].Declared = []proofv2.PageRole{proofv2.RoleInitiatorSigner}, nil
			}
		}
		ev := f.evidence(rep)
		facts := f.facts
		add("harbor: in the pages list only", caseOf(rep, ev, g0, g1.AuthoritySnapshot.Page, kp, xERPBook, &facts, nil, hashesOf(40), "bind"))
	}
	for _, c := range []struct {
		name string
		f    *x21
	}{
		{"principal not proven", newX21().drop(xPrincipal)},
		{"principal chain role missing", newX21().roles(xPrincipal, proofv2.RoleAuthorityPage)},
		{"principal chain on another partition", newX21().place(xPrincipal, partBVN2, blkY2)},
		{"authority book not proven", newX21().drop(xBook)},
		{"authority book without its role", newX21().roles(xBook, proofv2.RoleVoter)},
		{"authority page 1 not proven", newX21().drop(xBook1)},
		{"authority page 2 not proven", newX21().drop(xBook2)},
		{"authority page without its role", newX21().roles(xBook1, proofv2.RoleVoter)},
		{"header authority book not proven", newX21().drop(xHdrBook)},
		{"header authority page not proven", newX21().drop(xHdrPage)},
		{"header authority without its role", newX21().roles(xHdrBook, proofv2.RoleAuthorityBook)},
		{"delegate book not proven", newX21().drop(xDelBook)},
		{"delegate page not proven", newX21().drop(xDelPage)},
		{"delegate book without its role", newX21().roles(xDelBook, proofv2.RoleAuthorityBook)},
		{"voter page without the voter role", newX21().roles(xBook2, proofv2.RoleAuthorityPage)},
		{"delegated vote's origin without the voter role", newX21().roles(xDelPage, proofv2.RoleDelegatePage)},
		{"initiator page without its role", newX21().roles(xERP, proofv2.RoleVoter)},
		{"initiating signature's delegator not proven", newX21().drop(xERPDeleg)},
		{"certified key page not proven", newX21().drop(xERP)},
		{"page with no partition", newX21().place(xBook1, "", blkY2)},
		{"page with no block", newX21().place(xBook1, partBVN2, 0)},
		{"page on the transaction's partition at another block", newX21().place(xPrincipal, partBVN1, blkX+1)},
	} {
		add(c.name, bindOf(c.f))
	}
	{
		f := newX21()
		f.facts.Signatures[0].Block = blkY3 + 1
		add("signature after the page's block", bindOf(f))
		f = newX21()
		f.facts.Arrivals[0].Block = blkY2 + 1
		add("delegated vote after the page's block", bindOf(f))
		f = newX21()
		f.facts.Votes[0].Block = blkX + 1
		add("vote after the anchor block", bindOf(f))
		f = newX21()
		f.facts.Signatures[0].Block = blkY3 - 1
		add("signature earlier than its page's own block", bindOf(f))
	}
	{
		c := bindOf(newX21())
		c.G0.ExecMBI++
		add("G0 execution block", c)
		c = bindOf(newX21())
		c.G1Page = "acc://other.acme/book/1"
		add("G1 page", c)
		c = bindOf(newX21())
		c.Report.Proven = c.Report.Proven[:2]
		add("proven records that do not describe the pages", c)
		c = bindOf(newX21())
		c.Report.Unproven = []NamedOut{{Code: proofv2.StateCompletenessUnproven, Partition: partBVN1, Block: blkX, Detail: "appended"}}
		add("an unproven entry", c)
		c = bindOf(newX21())
		c.Report.Disclosures = []NamedOut{{Code: proofv2.StateVoteProductionUnbound, Partition: partBVN2, Block: blkY2, Detail: "unbound"}}
		add("a vote production not bound to the vote's message", c)
		c = bindOf(newX21())
		c.Report.Disclosures = []NamedOut{{Code: proofv2.StateAuthorityNotReady, Partition: partBVN2, Block: blkY2, Detail: "another disclosure"}}
		add("a disclosure that is not a refusal", c)
		c = bindOf(newX21())
		c.Facts.TxHash = hx32(99)
		add("another transaction's facts", c)
		c = bindOf(newX21())
		c.KeyBook = "acc://other.acme/book"
		add("another declared book", c)
		c = bindOf(newX21())
		c.KeyPage = "ACC://ERP.ACME/BOOK/1/"
		add("the certified page in another spelling", c)
	}
	add("level-20 delegate chain", bindOf(chainOf(20)))
	add("books beyond level 20 present too", bindOf(chainOf(23)))
	add("level 21 book only", bindOf(chainOf(21)))
	add("level 20 book missing", bindOf(chainOf(20).drop("acc://d19.acme/book")))
	add("level 20 page missing", bindOf(chainOf(20).drop("acc://d19.acme/book/1")))
	add("level 3 book missing", bindOf(chainOf(20).drop("acc://d2.acme/book")))
	add("level 21 book missing", bindOf(chainOf(21).drop("acc://d20.acme/book")))
	{
		f := chainOf(4)
		f.add(page("acc://d3.acme/book/1", xBook, "acc://d1.acme/book"), partBVN3, blkY3, proofv2.RoleDelegatePage)
		add("a delegation cycle", bindOf(f))
	}
	add("an unknown role", bindOf(newX21().roles(xHdrPage, proofv2.RoleHeaderAuthority, proofv2.PageRole("owner"))))
	{
		f := newX21()
		for _, u := range []string{xPrincipal, xBook, xBook1, xBook2, xHdrBook, xHdrPage, xDelBook, xDelPage, xERPDeleg} {
			f.drop(u)
		}
		add("only the certified page", bindOf(f))
	}
	return out
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
// mutation of scenarios

type IntentMutation struct {
	ID      string  `json:"id"`
	Base    int     `json:"base"`
	Op      string  `json:"op"`
	Patches []Patch `json:"patches"`
	Expect  RootOut `json:"expect"`
}

type IntentFile struct {
	Format      string           `json:"format"`
	Description string           `json:"description"`
	Source      string           `json:"source"`
	Bases       []*RootCase      `json:"bases"`
	BaseNames   []string         `json:"baseNames"`
	BaseExpect  []RootOut        `json:"baseExpect"`
	Named       []NamedFileEntry `json:"named"`
	Mutations   []IntentMutation `json:"mutations"`
	Skipped     struct {
		Panics    int `json:"panics"`
		NoVerdict int `json:"noVerdict"`
		Flaky     int `json:"flaky"`
	} `json:"skipped"`
}

type NamedFileEntry struct {
	Name   string    `json:"name"`
	Case   *RootCase `json:"case"`
	Expect RootOut   `json:"expect"`
}

// decodeStrict decodes a mutated scenario the way the TypeScript adapter reads it: no unknown member, every type as declared.
func decodeStrict(tree any) (*RootCase, bool) {
	raw, err := json.Marshal(tree)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, false
	}
	var c RootCase
	d := json.NewDecoder(bytes.NewReader(raw))
	d.DisallowUnknownFields()
	if err := d.Decode(&c); err != nil {
		return nil, false
	}
	return &c, true
}

// protectedIntent names the members a mutation does not touch: the account states of the report (the account decoder is exercised by the
// 2.1 corpus; here a flipped byte would only test it again) and the mode.
func protectedIntent(path []any) bool {
	if len(path) >= 2 && path[0] == "report" && path[1] == "pages" {
		return true
	}
	if len(path) >= 1 && path[0] == "mode" {
		return true
	}
	return false
}

func mutateIntent(r *rand.Rand, n node) (Patch, string, bool) {
	// the vote evidence is read with Go's decoder on both sides: every kind of mutation is a legitimate input there; elsewhere keep to the types
	free := len(n.path) >= 1 && n.path[0] == "voteEvidence"
	for tries := 0; tries < 6; tries++ {
		p, name := mutate(r, n, "")
		if p.Op == "rename" && !free {
			continue
		}
		return p, name, true
	}
	return Patch{}, "", false
}

func intentMutations(bases []*RootCase, names []string, per int, f *IntentFile) error {
	for bi, base := range bases {
		raw, _ := json.Marshal(base)
		var tree any
		if err := json.Unmarshal(raw, &tree); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		var nodes []node
		collect(tree, nil, &nodes)
		var usable []node
		for _, n := range nodes {
			if len(n.path) == 0 || protectedIntent(n.path) {
				continue
			}
			usable = append(usable, n)
		}
		for k := 0; k < per; k++ {
			r := rand.New(rand.NewSource(seedOf(names[bi], fmt.Sprint(k))))
			count := 1
			if r.Intn(4) == 0 {
				count = 2
			}
			var ps []Patch
			var ops []string
			for c := 0; c < count; c++ {
				t := usable[r.Intn(len(usable))]
				for tries := 0; tries < 4; tries++ {
					switch t.v.(type) {
					case map[string]any, []any:
						if r.Intn(3) != 0 {
							t = usable[r.Intn(len(usable))]
							continue
						}
					}
					break
				}
				p, name, good := mutateIntent(r, t)
				if !good {
					continue
				}
				ps = append(ps, p)
				ops = append(ops, name+"@"+pathString(p.Path))
			}
			if len(ps) == 0 {
				continue
			}
			mutated, ok := applyPatches(tree, ps)
			if !ok {
				continue
			}
			c, ok := decodeStrict(mutated)
			if !ok {
				f.Skipped.NoVerdict++
				continue
			}
			lastPanic = ""
			a, ok := runCase(c)
			if !ok {
				if lastPanic != "" {
					f.Skipped.Panics++
					fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "PANIC %s#%02d [%s]: %s\n", names[bi], k, strings.Join(ops, " + "), lastPanic)
				} else {
					f.Skipped.NoVerdict++
				}
				continue
			}
			b, ok := runCase(c)
			if !ok || a.V != b.V || (a.V != "plain" && a.Msg != b.Msg) {
				f.Skipped.Flaky++
				continue
			}
			f.Mutations = append(f.Mutations, IntentMutation{ID: fmt.Sprintf("%s#%02d", names[bi], k), Base: bi, Op: strings.Join(ops, " + "), Patches: ps, Expect: a})
		}
	}
	return nil
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
// the command

func intentCorpus(validator, out string, per int) error {
	f := &IntentFile{Format: "certen-sdk/s3-intent-corpus/v1", Source: "validator " + sourceCommit(validator),
		Description: "Scenarios of the evidence 2.1 binding and the govRoot v4 computation (mode bind: BindProofV21 over the facts; root: the 2.1 branch of ProofV2Root with the facts read from the intent's vote evidence; govroot: GovRootV4FromPortable alone), their named cases from pkg/intentcert/bind_v21_test.go, and typed mutations of the bases. Each verdict is the validator's own."}
	syn, base := syntheticBase()
	_ = syn
	mustRun(base, "ok")
	// the golden: govRoot v4 of the fixture with the golden's governance hashes is the committed golden's
	gold := &RootCase{}
	{
		_, c := syntheticBase()
		gf := newX21()
		rep, g0, g1, kp := gf.report()
		ev := gf.evidence(rep)
		facts := gf.facts
		h := XHashes{}
		raw, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(validator, "pkg", "intentcert", "testdata", "govroot_v4", "cross_partition_golden.json"))
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		var g struct {
			Inputs    map[string]string `json:"inputs"`
			GovRoot   string            `json:"govRootV4"`
			PagesRoot string            `json:"pagesRoot"`
			VotesRoot string            `json:"votesRoot"`
		}
		if err := json.Unmarshal(raw, &g); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		h = XHashes{g.Inputs["g0Hash"], g.Inputs["g1Hash"], g.Inputs["g2Hash"], g.Inputs["operationId"]}
		gold = caseOf(rep, ev, g0, g1.AuthoritySnapshot.Page, kp, g.Inputs["keyBook"], &facts, c.VoteEvidence, h, "govroot")
		gold.KeyPage = g.Inputs["keyPage"]
		o := mustRun(gold, "ok")
		if o.Root != g.GovRoot || o.PagesRoot != g.PagesRoot || o.VotesRoot != g.VotesRoot {
			return fmt.Errorf("the fixture's govRoot v4 %s / %s / %s is not the golden's %s / %s / %s", o.Root, o.PagesRoot, o.VotesRoot, g.GovRoot, g.PagesRoot, g.VotesRoot)
		}
	}
	govBase := *base
	govBase.Mode = "govroot"
	mustRun(&govBase, "ok")
	f.Bases = []*RootCase{base, &govBase, gold}
	f.BaseNames = []string{"synthetic-root", "synthetic-govroot", "golden-govroot"}
	b20 := base20(base)
	mustRun(b20, "ok")
	f.Bases = append(f.Bases, b20)
	f.BaseNames = append(f.BaseNames, "synthetic-root-20")
	bindBase := bindOf(newX21())
	mustRun(bindBase, "ok")
	f.Bases = append(f.Bases, bindBase)
	f.BaseNames = append(f.BaseNames, "synthetic-bind")
	if realBase, err := realIntentBase(validator); err != nil {
		return err
	} else if realBase != nil {
		mustRun(realBase, "ok")
		rg := *realBase
		rg.Mode = "govroot"
		mustRun(&rg, "ok")
		f.Bases = append(f.Bases, realBase, &rg)
		f.BaseNames = append(f.BaseNames, "real-root", "real-govroot")
	}
	for _, b := range f.Bases {
		o, _ := runCase(b)
		f.BaseExpect = append(f.BaseExpect, o)
	}
	for _, n := range namedScenarios() {
		f.Named = append(f.Named, NamedFileEntry{n.Name, n.C, n.Out})
	}
	if err := intentMutations(f.Bases, f.BaseNames, per, f); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	return writeGz(filepath.Join(out, "intent-cases.json.gz"), mustJSON(f))
}

func mustJSON(v any) []byte {
	b, err := json.Marshal(v)
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	return b
}

func sourceCommit(validator string) string {
	b, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(validator, ".git"))
	_ = b
	_ = err
	return "origin/main 3419863"
}

var _ = url.Parse
